card.what: The club's royal blue foam Type III life vest (lesson boats, North Texas Sailing School style): two thick foam front panels, three grey 38 mm webbing straps with black side-release buckles, one vertical strap on the right panel, long loose strap tails, lighter blue lining turned over the armholes and shoulders
card.boats: every crew member on every boat (SKM_<Role>_Vest, tailored over each MetaHuman sailor's polo by Tools/blender/build_vest.py, skinned like the polo by scripts/import_crew_clothes.py)
card.distance: the cockpit camera at 1 to 2 m; the helm's chest fills the frame in close-ups and photo mode
card.before: Graphics G8 / round 11 vest: two vertical straps on each panel (a ladder), bands bunched low, 46 x 32 mm buckles, 2.2 cm foam with a flat edge wall, light blue piping on every edge, 4 cm shoulder straps, short tails from the far side

standin: Tools/boatkit/partloop/vest_standin.py: a faceless 1.78 m mannequin in a polo (the MetaHuman polos are in the private crew pack); every size below is measured on it

references.use: layout, strap and buckle positions, tails, binding, proportions (three-quarter, seated)
references.url: Bean's lesson photo IMG_9227 (Oct 4 2026, project files sailing-sim-ref/j22-lessons): shows people, measuring only, never in the repo

references.note: 1.5 in side-release buckle set: 3 in (76 mm) long overall, 1.75 in (44 mm) wide, 0.5 in (13 mm) thick; 1.5 in webbing is 38 mm

sizes.name: Buckle, female + visible male, along the strap
Front foam, shirt to shell, at the chest
sizes.source: estimate from the photo's rolled armhole edge (no listing gives it): reported, loose tolerance

sizes.name: Strap heights up from the hem, fraction of the vest's front height

features.text: Two thick, flat foam front panels meeting closed at the front
Three grey webbing straps across the front, the top one at the armpits
Black side-release buckles beside the opening on the wearer's left panel, the male tongue crossing the opening
One vertical strap on the wearer's right panel only, crossing the lower two bands
Loose strap ends from the opening: a short tab from the top strap, two long tails hanging down past the hem
Lighter blue lining turned over the armholes and shoulders; hem and opening the shell's own blue
Rolled, rounded foam edges (not a thin lip)
Wide shoulder straps over the top of the shoulder, a shallow V neckline at the front
No maker's logo or school letters (the photo's X2O / NTSS marks are left off: not ours to copy)

budget.note: skinned garment; the G8 vest was 15k on the stand-in
